_meta._comment: The stars that ARRIVE — GENERATED by tools/pipeline/import-gaia-neighbours.js --write (plan 28 §D). The Gaia DR3 six-dimensional stars within 1.5 kpc brighter than M_G 2 that ever reach V 8 within ±50 Myr on their Galactic orbits (ONE home packages/physics/src/sky/galactic-orbits.cjs), the stars of the Hipparcos catalogue (stars.json) excluded. The data are in stars-gaia.bin: Float32 little-endian COLUMN-MAJOR arrays, `columns` in order, `n` rows each — the astrometry at the Gaia epoch J2016.0, NOT propagated: the scene moves each star on its orbit. V and B−V are from G and BP−RP through the cubic polynomials in `colourRelations`, fitted here on the Hipparcos-matched rows. Gate: tools/verify/star-catalogue.js.

units.pmRaMasYr: milliarcseconds per Julian year, μα cos δ

colourRelations.form: c0 + c1·x + c2·x² + c3·x³, x = BP−RP clamped to colourFitRange; fitted on the Gaia rows matching a star of stars.json (V, B−V from the Hipparcos Catalogue), three passes of 3σ clipping

_meta.orbitModel: packages/physics/src/sky/galactic-orbits.cjs — the potential's exact evaluator (RK4, 0.5-Myr steps, the Sun on the same schedule); the closed form's amplitude counted as a diagnostic

source.title: Gaia DR3 (Gaia Collaboration 2023, A&A 674, A1): gaia_source within 1.5 kpc with radial velocities, brighter than M_G 2, joined to hipparcos2_best_neighbour — ESA, hosted by the Gaia archive
source.query: SELECT g.source_id, g.ra, g.dec, g.parallax, g.parallax_error, g.pmra, g.pmdec, g.radial_velocity, g.radial_velocity_error, g.phot_g_mean_mag, g.bp_rp, x.original_ext_source_id AS hip FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source AS g LEFT OUTER JOIN gaiadr3.hipparcos2_best_neighbour AS x ON x.source_id = g.source_id WHERE g.random_index BETWEEN <lo> AND <hi> AND g.parallax > 0.667 AND g.parallax_over_error > 5 AND g.radial_velocity IS NOT NULL AND g.pmra IS NOT NULL AND g.parallax < POWER(10, (12 - g.phot_g_mean_mag)/5)   — 32 chunks of random_index covering 0..1811709770, concatenated
